meta.title: Bumbli: a family game
meta.description: A family game where real chores unlock chapters of your shared story.

landing.title: Bumbli
landing.pitch: A family game where real chores unlock chapters of your shared story.
landing.eyebrow: A game for the whole family
landing.trust: No passwords, no email: everyone signs in with a personal link.

steps.d: Name the family and add everyone, from toddlers to grandparents. Each person gets a personal link.
The game master runs your shared story and sets quests that suit each person's age.
Real chores like tidying up or a walk move the plot forward and grow your heroes' skills.

peek.gm: Night falls over Quiet Hills. Something rustles in the barn. Who looks inside first?
peek.kid: Me! I will just grab a flashlight first.
peek.quest: Quest of the day: help Grandma sort the pantry

new.heading: Create your family
new.title: Family name
new.name: Your name
new.linksHint: Send everyone their own link. Opening it signs them into the game. Each link is personal, do not share it.
new.intro: A family name, your name and a couple of interests: the game master will build a story around you.
new.addMore: Add everyone else while they are around. You can also do it later on the Family page.
